comment: Coverage ratchet baseline. Raise with scripts/coverage_ratchet.py --update; lowering needs --force and shows in the diff.
tolerance_evidence: Local (container, g++ 13.3.0) and CI (ubuntu-24.04, gcc-13, MS_LINK_TESTS_SHARED=ON) measured the same tree at 54bcbd0 and agreed on all three metrics to within the 0.1 resolution lcov reports -- CI's regenerated docs/STATUS.md differed from the local one by the timestamp line alone. 0.5 points is ~10x that observed spread: above any noise seen so far, and far below what removing a test suite would cost.
